pages.text: Today, the classroom had a puppet show. A little drum stood before Duri.
"When the wolf appears, I will beat the drum." Duri held drumsticks in both hands.
The puppet show began. Duri sat in place before the drum.
Duri's eyes turned to the window. A sparrow sat on the frame.
A wolf puppet appeared onstage. Duri was watching only the sparrow.
The stage was quiet. The wolf quietly slipped back inside.
Holding the drumsticks, Duri looked around. "Oh? Was it my turn?"
Teacher Bau pointed at the stage. "Where will the wolf appear?"
Duri watched only the stage, gripping both drumsticks tightly.
The wolf appeared again. Boom, boom, Duri beat the drum. The children clapped.
